preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and the distance d must satisfy 2 <= d <= n <= 200000.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: The edges must form a valid tree with n nodes.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= m1 <= n and 1 <= m2 <= n and len(set(a)) == m1 and len(set(b)) == m2
preconditions.description: The sequences of nodes for both pieces must be valid and contain distinct elements.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of steps required to move the pieces.
